name: build-a-brand
description: Back-and-forth design interview that builds a brand identity tailored to the user's own business, never copied from others. Covers touchpoints, style and audience (B2B, B2C, B2M, M2M/MCP), then distinct directions, mockups (landing page, business card, slides) and a style brief. Use whenever someone wants to create or rethink how their brand looks.
